name: circularity-hub
description: Circularity Repair Cafe Hub: repair cafe management on a free Cloudflare account

scripts.cf:dev: pnpm --filter @circularity/cloudflare run build:web && pnpm --filter @circularity/cloudflare exec wrangler dev
scripts.cf:test: pnpm --filter @circularity/shared build && pnpm --filter @circularity/web exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm --filter @circularity/cloudflare test
